segments.text: Upfront is a word every contractor uses. Here is what it has to mean.
Before work starts, you see the scope. Every room, every action, every line.
You see the quote set against that scope, before anybody lifts a tool.
While the work runs, updates come to you on a schedule. Not when you chase us.
Every reading, every photograph, every change to the scope is recorded, and visible to you.
If the scope changes, you hear it from us before it appears on an invoice.
And when it is finished, you are told it is finished, with the evidence that says so.
No surprises is not a promise. It is a process.
